idea-plugin.name: HTTP Client
idea-plugin.description:
Lightweight HTTP client with endpoint discovery and request history.

Usage / 使用手册

  1. Open the HTTP Client tool window (right side or View | Tool Windows).
  2. Click the gutter icon on Spring Controller methods or use Add to Call List to generate a request; or create a new tab and enter the URL manually.
  3. Fill params/headers/body and click Send. Save requests to organize them in groups.

Response

  • Raw/Render/Headers views, JSON/XML/HTML/image rendering, and cURL copy.
  • Auto-detects local server port from run logs; defaults to 8080 if not detected.

使用提示

  • 支持从 Spring 注解与 Router Function 识别接口。
  • 左侧接口列表支持分组、搜索、拖拽排序。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.0.2

  • 中文：新增前置/后置脚本能力，可在发送前后动态处理 URL、参数、Header、Cookie 与响应数据。
  • 中文：新增脚本环境变量管理（项目级/全局级），并支持脚本内通过 env/store 读取与写入。
  • 中文：新增脚本说明、示例与片段插入，支持脚本片段选择与彩色图标入口，降低脚本编写门槛。
  • 中文：新增 jvm bridge，可通过 jvm.type("全限定类名") 直接调用项目依赖库的静态方法。
  • 中文：脚本引擎增强，支持 ES6 模板字符串（反引号插值）与 log.info/log.warn/log.error 方式记录日志。
  • English: Added pre/post scripting to mutate request and response data around execution.
  • English: Added project/global environment variable manager and script-side env/store APIs.
  • English: Added script docs, templates, and snippets with improved snippet picker and colored action icons.
  • English: Added JVM bridge via jvm.type("FQCN") so scripts can call static methods from project dependencies.
  • English: Script runtime now supports ES6 template literals and log.info/log.warn/log.error aliases.

v0.0.1

  • 中文：首次发布，提供接口扫描、请求历史与响应渲染等基础功能。
  • English: Initial release with endpoint discovery, request history, and response rendering.
